Reliability Specialist

Canada, British Columbia, Kitimat-stikine

Fulltime: 40 hrs a week

Experience: > 10 years

Mining

Introduction

Our client is seeking a motivated Reliability Specialist to support operational reliability, asset performance, and continuous improvement initiatives within a large industrial facility. This site-based role will work closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and Technical teams to improve equipment reliability, eliminate recurring defects, and drive sustainable operational performance.

What are you going to do

* Provide frontline reliability support for day-to-day operational and equipment performance issues.* Facilitate root cause investigations and problem-solving activities using appropriate reliability and incident investigation methodologies.
* Conduct bad actor reviews and develop strategies to eliminate repeat equipment and process failures.* Analyze operational and maintenance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for reliability improvement.
* Develop insights and recommendations using reliability tools and analytical techniques such as Pareto analysis.* Support the continuous improvement of asset and equipment care plans.
* Work closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and Technical teams to improve plant performance and reliability.* Support site reliability programs by identifying, prioritizing, and mitigating reliability threats and opportunities.
* Coach and mentor engineers, technicians, supervisors, and other stakeholders in reliability best practices and problem-solving techniques.* Promote a proactive defect elimination culture across the organization.
* Support the development of reliability reports, presentations, and performance metrics for management and operational stakeholders.* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, production, reliability, and asset performance.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop and implement sustainable solutions to technical and operational challenges.

Essential skills and knowledge 

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering discipline.* Maintenance Technologists, Reliability Specialists, and asset management professionals with relevant experience are encouraged to apply.
* Up to 5 years of experience within an industrial, manufacturing, processing, energy, mining, petrochemical, or similar operational environment.* Strong understanding of reliability engineering principles and methodologies.
* Experience applying reliability tools such as: * Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)* Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
* Reliability Block Diagrams (RBD)* Life Cycle Cost Analysis (LCCA)
* Weibull Analysis* Experience developing reports, dashboards, presentations, and performance metrics.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.* Ability to work collaboratively across teams
* Strong interest in asset reliability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.* Eligibility to obtain or maintain Professional Engineering registration is considered an asset.
* Willingness to work in an industrial plant environment* Exposure to condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, and asset performance management programs.
* Experience supporting reliability improvement projects

What we offer

Brunel provides the opportunity to work on major projects with leading organizations in mining, energy, infrastructure, and related technical industries. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful assignments that support project execution, operational readiness, and long-term business success.

Closing: September 11, 2026

Our Culture and Values

At Brunel, we are proud of our unique corporate culture, which is shaped and nurtured by the collective efforts of our employees. Our work environment is characterised by an authentic, communicative and inclusive approach to teamwork that fosters an atmosphere of collaboration and creativity. Our values are at the center of everything we do – for our clients, our colleagues and ourselves.

Learn more about our global network of specialists!

Our ESG Commitment

Since 1975, our mission has always been to connect specialists to exciting career opportunities, to support the development of these careers, and to offer fair and equal employment. This has enabled us to create a truly sustainable and durable business model. Having a passion for people and caring deeply for the environment is not only part of Brunel’s DNA but is also reflected in our culture and values. As a global company, we take our social responsibility very seriously.
